title: Energy map: reading the seven levels

seo.title: The chakra section in a destiny matrix reading
seo.description: Chakras in the destiny matrix: seven levels and three columns of matter, energy and feeling. How the column totals show which area is sagging.
queries: energy map in the destiny matrix
chakras in the destiny matrix meaning

meaning: The chakra energy map in the destiny matrix is a separate table in the report, where a whole life is laid out across seven levels and three columns. The seven rows are the seven chakras, from the support at the bottom to meaning at the top; the three columns show which plane each area lives on: body and money, force and will, or feeling. The position does not answer “who are you by the chart” — it answers “where are you full and where are you empty”, which areas are filled and which ones fall through.

Unlike the centre or the relationship line, this is not a single point but a cut through the whole chart at once: each chakra gathers its own theme — from material support and pleasure to standing, love, self-expression, intuition and the link to the family line. The point of the section is that one and the same area can be lived in three ways — earned (matter), pushed with force (energy) and felt (emotions). The map shows which of the three planes works for a person and which one is blocked.

A strong reading looks like an even map with no holes: the columns come out comparable, and no row hangs at zero. A weak one is a sharp tilt. A full column of matter with empty feeling gives an outwardly successful person who lives dry; the opposite case is a fine inner life with no money and no household. An empty bottom row almost always weighs more than a rich top one: without support the upper levels do not hold, however much is gathered above.

What the energy map affects is where a person draws force and where it drains away: a filled chakra works like a source, a collapsed one like a hole that swallows energy and attention. The practical use of the position is not to admire the strong rows but to find the weakest one and work out which plane will top it up — work, action or relationships. That is why the section counts as the clearest in the report: it shows the tilt of a whole character, not the value of one cell.

article_sections.h2: How the energy map is built in the destiny matrix
paragraphs: The energy map is a table of seven rows and three columns: Physics, Energy, Emotions. Each row takes two arcana from the chart that has already been worked out, and the third value comes out by itself: emotions are the reduced sum of physics and energy in the same row. Under the table stand the column totals, also reduced sums of all seven values. Rows and columns describe ways of living a theme, not the state of the body. Meaning appears in comparison: column against column, row against row, a repeat against a gap. A single cell pulled out of its row and column says little.

article_sections.h2: Seven levels: from material support to meaning
paragraphs: The rows run from top to bottom, from Sahasrara down to Muladhara, and each one asks its own question. Muladhara at the bottom is support: a home, a month of reserves, the feeling of ground underfoot. Svadhisthana is joy, children, craft, everything done out of wanting. Manipura is will, standing and the price a person can say out loud. Anahata is closeness and what it turns into in everyday life. Vishuddha is the word: whether promises are kept and whether a person can say no. Ajna is vision and trust in your own hunches. Sahasrara is the link to a larger design and the question of what will be left afterwards. The bottom row holds the upper ones: empty support is felt more sharply than rich meaning.

article_sections.h2: The Physics column: how a theme becomes action
paragraphs: Physics is the observable form: what a person does, buys, arranges and finishes at the chosen level. In Muladhara it holds the arcanum of the birth year: stamina, housing, money in the account — the footing that long things rest on. In Manipura it is money and standing, the level of pay a person should not go below. In Vishuddha it is the work where a voice turns into a result: negotiation, writing, teaching, sales. A strong reading of this column names a deed and its circumstances. Checking it is simple: find one episode from last month where the theme of the row became visible action, and compare it with the description of the arcanum.

article_sections.h2: The Energy column: what starts a process and keeps it going
paragraphs: Energy is the way a person switches on: through interest, order, contact, movement, a pause or a piece of research. In Muladhara it holds the karmic task, in Sahasrara the arcanum of the birth month, and in Manipura energy matches physics, because both cells take the arcanum of the centre. The column answers the question of stamina: is there enough spark after the first refusal, and does a person manage to come back to the work a second time. Read it next to physics — does action appear after the impulse, and does it hold on a repeat. Ordinary swings of strength come from load and tiredness, while the column is about the way of switching on.

article_sections.h2: The Emotions column: how the theme of a level is felt
paragraphs: Emotions is the only column worked out from the other two: in every row it is the reduced sum of physics and energy. Hence its meaning — the response that is left after the action and the motive. In Manipura it is about anger and dignity: live anger holds a boundary, suppressed anger turns into resentment of people who succeed. In Anahata it is about attachment, jealousy and tenderness. In Vishuddha it is about being honest with yourself: you said what you thought, and you are calm after the conversation. When the response falls out of step with the two neighbouring cells of the row, it helps more to talk about words and boundaries than about a “closed” chakra.

Three totals stand under the table — the reduced sums of physics, energy and emotions. They show which plane a person lives on more often: work, effort or feeling. A high in a row means a resource and, at the same time, the habit of solving everything one way. A low is the easiest entry, a convenient place to start watching. The arithmetic gap between totals does not prove a tilt on its own: it needs facts beside it, showing where exactly the theme of a row runs into nothing. The most useful check is totals against the bottom rows: a full column of matter over empty support looks like a successful person living dry.

article_sections.h2: Repeated arcana and gaps between columns
paragraphs: The same arcanum usually turns up in the table more than once: there are twenty-one cells and twenty-two arcana in all. A repeat means one shared way of acting that answers several row questions at once, and copying the wording across word for word is useless — action, motive and response sound different even under one number. A gap between the columns of one row shows where a theme lives on one plane and falls through on another: the work moves, and there is no joy in it at all. Such a gap is checked against the facts of the month, and the conclusion ends with an observation you can test, not with a verdict about the state of the body.

article_sections.h2: An example reading of the map for 4–3–22
paragraphs: Top to bottom, the physics column of the reference matrix 4–3–22 goes: The Emperor, The Hanged Man, Strength, The Hanged Man, The Emperor, Strength, The Fool. The energy column goes: The Empress, The Wheel, The Chariot, Justice, The Emperor, The Devil, Justice. The three column totals come out as The Chariot, The Chariot and Temperance. Read the pattern, not a single number: The Emperor and The Hanged Man alternate, so structure and pause replace each other every other level. In Manipura both cells are taken by the four, because physics and energy there come from the centre, and the emotion comes out as Strength. Matching totals for physics and energy say that the material rhythm and the spread of effort agree here, while the emotional total is gentler than both.

article_sections.h2: Practice: read the map from a row to an action
paragraphs: Pick one row where the three columns diverge the most. Write down three things from a single real episode: what you did, what switched you on, and what response was left afterwards. Then think of the smallest possible step — saying a need out loud, changing one condition, or finishing what you started. Work with one row for a week, then move to the next. That pace protects you from the main mistake: reading the whole table at once and remembering only the prettiest cells. Lasting questions about how you feel stay outside the map, and belong with a qualified specialist.

faq.q: What do the chakras show in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: Seven levels of life in three planes at once: physics is what a person does, energy is what switches them on, emotions are the response that is left. The rows run from support at the bottom to meaning at the top. The conclusion comes from comparing columns, totals and repeats, not from one bright cell.

faq.q: How do you read the energy map in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: Start with the weakest row, not the most noticeable one. Read it across the three columns, find one real episode from the month, and see which plane works and which one sags. Then check the row against the column totals under the table.

faq.q: How is the chakra energy map worked out in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: Every row takes two arcana from the chart already worked out — physics and energy. The third value, emotions, is their reduced sum. A column total is found the same way: its seven values are added up and reduced to the range 1–22.

faq.q: What does the lowest value in a row of the energy map mean?
faq.a: That this plane of the theme is worked out less than the others, and short steps are the easier way into it. A low describes how reachable a way of acting is. It says nothing about a person’s worth, and nothing about an area being off limits.

faq.q: Does the energy map assess the state of the body?
faq.a: No. Rows and columns are a symbolic model of behaviour and feeling, not a medical examination. Lasting questions about how you feel are settled with a qualified specialist, while the map is used to watch deeds and responses.
